boundary: Exact cat-state parity-fusion algebra plus an explicit independent-erasure resource model. Measurement error, correlated erasures, leakage propagation, feed-forward latency, crosstalk, readout hardware and fault tolerance remain external.

three_parallel_fusion_ancillas.note: reuse the clock as one parity ancilla and add two dual-rail ancilla triples

fusion_primitive.accepted_output: GHZ_(m+n) up to a tracked block-X Pauli frame
fusion_primitive.failure_model: if either fusion CNOT erases, both input blocks are conservatively discarded and rebuilt
fusion_primitive.input: GHZ_m on block A, GHZ_n on block B, reusable logical ancilla f initialized to |0>
steps: measure f in Z with erasure flag
if parity=1 update the logical-X frame of block B; no physical fanout is required
